Double filtration plasma exchange was performed... Immunoadsorption therapy was then performed

extractions.value: Double filtration plasma exchange was performed with PVA (Plasmacure, Kuraray, Japan) as the first filter and Evaflux 2A (Kuraray, Japan) as the second. Plasma exchange was carried out four times on an alternate-day schedule. The total amount of plasma processed was about 12 liters... He was treated with an immunoadsorption therapy with a tryptophan-linked PVA (TR-350, Asahi Medical, Japan) by batchwise adsorption method. Plasmapheresis was carried out five times on an alternate-day schedule. The total amount of plasmapheresis processed was about 10 liters.

extractions.value: Patient had prior early-stage lung cancer (adenocarcinoma) at age 51 and left cerebral thrombosis at age 53. Initially misdiagnosed with progressive dermatosclerosis. It appears likely that our case had an unknown antibody, and that stiff-man syndrome is heterogenous.
